description: This file initializes a React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM. It sets up the root element, applies strict mode for highlighting potential problems, and imports necessary dependencies including React, ReactDOM, CSS, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React elements into, replacing the older ReactDOM.render API.

methods.name: document.getElementById
methods.description: DOM API to get a DOM element by its ID, used here to specify where to mount the React application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified DOM node.
